rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=6, train_n=200, n_iter=225, val_n=32, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-20 FINAL ITER (hard stop) -- CEILING-DOCUMENTATION via the WIDEST scored basis to date. SEARCHED knob (ONE): val_n 16->32 on the iter-4 ep6 PEAK cfg (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=6, lr=1e-4, unet_c=16, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42 -> 0.9596). val_n is the ONLY allowed knob {n_iter,val_n,warm_start,pretrain_epochs,grad_clip} not exhausted in BOTH directions: it has been read at 16 (9-seed band mean ~0.9598, 1-sigma ~0.0011) and at 24 (iter-9 0.9609, iter-13 0.9607) but NEVER at 32. Widening the scored set 16->32 perturbs ONLY which/how-many per-scan-fit images are averaged into the SSIM mean, not any optimization-strength knob, so it is the cleanest remaining test of whether the ~0.96 ceiling is a small-sample (16/24-scan) artefact. BUDGET-FIT (not the searched knob; n_iter is a proven-dead lever): n_iter 300->225 to hold per-scan compute constant -- 32 scans * 225 steps = 7200 step-units = the 24*300 of iter-13 (~700-720s, well under the 900s/15-min wall). n_iter down also cannot HURT differently than the known n_iter-overfit direction (iter-2 n_iter600 0.9553->0.9407 was UP; 225<300 is LESS per-scan overfit if anything). EXHAUSTED levers AVOIDED: lr anchored 1e-4 (iter-3 0.9553->0.9593); pretrain_epochs ep6 PEAK (ep3->6 up 0.9596, ep9 DOWN 0.9593 iter-10, ep12 down 0.9585 iter-5); unet_c flat (iter-6 c16->c32 0.9596->0.9495); grad_clip insensitive BOTH directions (iter-8 tighter 0.5=0.9597, iter-11 looser 2.0=0.9592); seed noise-stable over 9 draws (0.9576-0.9612, mean 0.9598); warm_start LOAD-BEARING-POSITIVE, kept True NEVER off; the optimizer field is a DEAD knob (warm-start pre-pass + _fit_one_scene HARDCODE Adam, no scheduler hook; activating either needs editing the FORBIDDEN shared solver). FAILURE MODE: per-image U-Net N2I on dense-view 128-angle breast is STRUCTURALLY FBP-BOUNDED -- the half-angle Noise2Inverse view-split discards angular information the full-view 128-view LD-FBP keeps, so each per-scan GT-free fit caps BELOW the LD-FBP baseline (hr=0); a substrate ceiling, not an optimization/capacity one. HYPOTHESIS: reading the peak recon on 32 val scans lands WITHIN the established ~0.96 band (hr stays 0), confirming the breast per-image U-Net N2I ceiling is val-subset-stable on the WIDEST basis tested and not a 16/24-scan sampling artefact -- the final ceiling-documentation datapoint. A material drop/lift would only be a read-sampling note, not a climbable lever. WALL: iter-13 (val_n24, n_iter300) ran ~700-720s; iter-20 holds step-units constant (32*225 = 24*300) -> est ~700-720s, well under the 900s/15-min wall (outer_wall_s=1500 hard cap).
